mapper.select: SELECT id, out_no AS outNo, customer_id AS customerId, out_date AS outDate, total_amount AS totalAmount, status FROM sal_outstock WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM sal_outstock_detail WHERE deleted = 0 AND out_id = #{outId}
SELECT id, instock_no AS instockNo, supplier_id AS supplierId, instock_date AS instockDate, total_amount AS totalAmount, status FROM pur_instock WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT tax_rate FROM pur_instock_detail WHERE deleted = 0 AND instock_id = #{instockId}

SELECT id, name FROM base_customer WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN
#{id}

SELECT id, name FROM base_supplier WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN
#{id}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amountSum, COALESCE(SUM(tax_amount), 0) AS taxSum FROM inv_sales_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (10, 20) AND invoice_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amountSum, COALESCE(SUM(tax_amount), 0) AS taxSum FROM inv_purchase_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (10, 20) AND auth_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT MONTH(invoice_date) AS month, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalSum, COALESCE(SUM(tax_amount), 0) AS taxSum FROM inv_sales_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (10, 20) AND invoice_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY MONTH(invoice_date)

SELECT MONTH(invoice_date) AS month, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalSum, COALESCE(SUM(tax_amount), 0) AS taxSum FROM inv_purchase_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (10, 20) AND invoice_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY MONTH(invoice_date)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amountSum FROM sal_outstock WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 10 AND customer_id = #{partnerId} AND out_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amountSum FROM inv_sales_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (10, 20) AND customer_id = #{partnerId} AND invoice_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amountSum FROM pur_instock WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 10 AND supplier_id = #{partnerId} AND instock_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amountSum FROM inv_purchase_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (10, 20) AND supplier_id = #{partnerId} AND invoice_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
